Pressure regulator for nitrogen services.
Multiple tags (PCV 204-12, PCV 207-07, etc.).
Max flow rates vary between 3990 ft/hr and 100 SCFM.
Operating pressure ranges from 2 psig to 170 psig.
Body material is carbon steel with various sizes (2", 1", 1/2").
Spring material is steel, case is cast iron or cast steel.
Packing and seal material is Jorcote on SST.
Flow direction is straight through.
Required seat tightness is Class IV.
Manufacturer: Jordan, model number: MK60.
Pressure regulator specifications for multiple nitrogen services.
Tags include PCV 207-11, PCV 207-12, PCV 207-13, and PCV 201-16A/B.
Services range from Nitrogen Main Header to Nitrogen Purge.
Materials used: Carbon Steel, Steel, Jorcote on SST, and EPDM.
Manufacturer is Jordan for most components.
The document contains specifications for pressure regulators used in nitrogen services.
There are four tags (PCV 204-26A, PCV 204-26B, PCV 1-254-20, PCV 2-254-20, PCV 3-254-20, PCV 4-254-20) each with specific service details.
All regulators are self-contained and made of carbon steel.
The pressure range for all regulators is from .5 to 1.5 psig.
The maximum operating temperature for all regulators is 125 Deg. F.
The document specifies two pressure regulators for nitrogen purge services.
Both regulators have the same specifications except for some differences in pressure and temperature limits.
The body material is carbon steel with a self-contained design.
Spring material is steel, and packing is made of 416 SST.
The flow direction is straight through, and seat tightness is Class IV.
